title: Anova Multi-Bath Session Overlap
app: Meater probes, Anova Precision Cooker sessions, Instant Pot logs, wine-fridge sensors, ESPHome kitchen sensors, and pantry inventory feeds via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=anova:session
| bin _time span=30m
| stats dc(session_id) as concurrent_sessions by device _time
| where concurrent_sessions>1
| sort - concurrent_sessions
description: Uses Anova device sessions telemetry to monitor time windows where one device was asked to support multiple overlapping jobs in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for scheduling collisions that complicate kitchen workflow, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Anova device sessions data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Thirty-minute chart of concurrent Anova sessions.
grandmaExplanation: It frames time windows where one device was asked to support multiple overlapping jobs so you can spot scheduling collisions that complicate kitchen workflow before it becomes annoying.
